_comment: A 64-channel spinning lidar: uniform beams over a symmetric 45 degree vertical FOV. 360 degrees
renders as 3 views of 120. Participating media (attenuation and backscatter in dust, smoke and fog)
is off: CitySample's streets have none, and it costs GPU time every scan. Each range gets a
Gaussian error of 3 cm standard deviation along its beam (range_noise_stddev_m; add
range_noise_stddev_fraction for noise that grows with range).
